runs.description: Synthetic dataset built to validate an analysis pipeline, not a field survey. 297 observations, 113 covariates named cov_000 through cov_112 drawn from standard normal distributions, and a target SOC_MgHa (soil organic carbon, megagrams per hectare). A small number of the covariates carry a deliberately planted linear relationship with the target; the remainder are pure noise. Which ones is not recorded here. Two GEE export artifact columns (a row index and a constant empty geometry) were dropped before upload.
runs.name: Synthetic SOC control - contract probe

datasets.description: One row per observation. cov_000..cov_112 are unitless standardised covariates. SOC_MgHa is the response, soil organic carbon in Mg/ha, roughly 50-200.
datasets.name: synthetic_soc.csv
